description.value: Sunrise Pizza & Steak House is a neighbourhood pizzeria on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most celebrated cycling corridors on the East Side. The broad menu spans handmade pizzas with fresh homemade crust, Greek specialties, Italian dishes, seafood, and steaks, making it well-suited for groups with varied tastes. Online ordering with delivery is available, offering a convenient refueling option for cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 89m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sunrisepizza.ca confirms the OSM address, phone number, and that the business is an active full-service restaurant. The site features an online ordering system with a cart and explicitly promotes delivery, confirming takeout/delivery service. A dedicated 'Vegetarian Pizza' appears in the menu text, confirming vegetarian options. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (dinner-only Tue–Thu) conflicts with website, which advertises extended lunch service from 11:30 AM Tue–Fri; OSM tags appear outdated.
OSM address field lacks postal code; website provides full address including V5L 3W8.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with a broad menu and online ordering; however, no bike parking or any cycling-specific amenity is confirmed, making it a marginal WWC fit without further on-the-ground verification.

Takeout.detail: Website prominently features 'Order Online Delivery' with a full cart-based online ordering system, confirming at minimum delivery and online ordering service

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated Vegetarian Pizza (mushrooms, green peppers, onions, tomatoes, pineapple, olives, cheese & tomato sauce)

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Medium pizzas $21–27; pizzeria with delivery service
